This reproduces/refutes mechanism exactly.

chunk_findings.detail: In the normal path this comment block exists to handle, the landing has uncommitted event shards and `EC.commit_at(...)` creates a bookkeeping shard commit on the base before the merge. The new code captures `merge_since` *before* that shard commit and then passes it to `check_after_merge(..., since=merge_since)`. If `check_after_merge` uses that `since` as the lower bound of the range to inspect, the range is pre-shard..final-merge-sha, so it includes the shard commit it was supposed to exclude. For example, when the only new commit on the target is the bookkeeping shard commit (such as an already-up-to-date merge after committing shards), the after-merge CI tripwire is still given a non-empty range containing that shard commit, contrary to the added comment’s promise that the CI will “check user changes rather than re-checking a shard commit.” The previous `since=landed_before` (read after the shard commit) excluded that commit.
chunk_findings.title: ddflow/api/lifecycle/merge.py (merge_since / check_after_merge call)

chunk_findings.detail: `merge_since` is read at line 193 *before* `EC.commit_at` creates the landing’s own shard commit. If the base is `B`, `EC.commit_at` moves `wt.base` to shard commit `S`, and the merge then produces `M`, this line passes `since=B` to `check_after_merge`. The standard post-merge range `since..sha` now includes `S`, the bookkeeping commit the new comment explicitly says must not be re-checked. The pre-change lower bound (`landed_before`, captured after `EC.commit_at`) is the correct exclusive start and excludes `S`. As written, every merge will hand the tripwire check a range containing its own self-generated shard commit, exactly the behavior the change claims to avoid.

data.probe: check_after_merge's since is 'the base the merge started from' (ddflow/api/ci.py docstring); the test asserts since == the target HEAD captured before merge_item (pre-shard). The shard commit touches only .ddflow/events/* shards, which no tripwire files: pattern matches (^frozen/), so a range containing it re-checks nothing a tripwire can fire on. B6b7e47955e silently moved since post-shard; the test pins pre-shard.
